caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, round-bodied pottery jar positioned upright at the center of a plain, light-colored background. The jar has a wide mouth with a slightly thickened rim and two small, rounded handles on opposite sides near the top. The main color of the jar is a deep, reddish-brown, with the upper two-thirds being more uniform in color while the lower third transitions to a lighter brown with irregular, patchy areas of white and light, mottled spots, resembling mineral deposits or surface wear. The interior of the jar is visible and shows shading to suggest depth, with the rim casting a shadow inside. The composition is simple, featuring only the jar, and the background remains unembellished, focusing attention solely on the pottery piece.
title: Large Earthen Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
